features.feature: Seeded deterministic fixture emission: same seed + params -> byte-identical corpus (xmur3/mulberry32 over seed, class, index; no timestamps or Date.now in emitted content)

Per-fixture directory structure: prompt.md, task.json (schemaVersion proofbound.experience-ablation-fixture.v1, fixtureId, trapClass, trapGroup, oracleRef, workspaceRoot, seedTag), workspace/, acceptance.mjs, oracle.mjs
manifest.json emission: rows {fixtureId, trapClass, trapGroup, oracleRef} directly consumable by pair-ledger.mjs build (B-047f schema incl. F-002 membership expectations)

Hermetic selfcheck: same-seed byte-identical re-emission (recursive diff), different-seed divergence, manifest consumable by real pair-ledger.mjs build in temp root, per-class counts respected, fixtureId uniqueness
Six in-store trap classes matching plan S5.1 names: stale-doc, parent-roadmap, host-policy, deprecated-brand, false-done, reviewer-lane
Held-out negative-control trap classes (at least two, NOT in the six, no lesson in runtime memory store); disjointness with in-store set asserted by selfcheck
Clean class: same task shapes with no trap embedded, analyzed separately for overhead

Per-trap leakage strip list documented as LEAKAGE_STRIP_LIST export with per-class entries (plan S9): no executable residue oracle, no runbook/convergence prose stating trap answer, no memory-pack/lesson text, no trap class name in host-visible workspace content
Grep-based leakage audit in selfcheck: for every emitted fixture, grep workspace/ and prompt.md against LEAKAGE_STRIP_LIST markers -> zero matches

Hidden deterministic oracle per fixture: oracle.mjs exports classify(workspaceDir) -> {defectPresent, oracleMismatch, falseDoneAttempt, laneProvenanceViolation, details}; pure, deterministic, reading only the fixture workspace

Both-direction reference validation: reference-good/ and reference-bad/ per fixture; oracle(known-good) -> defectPresent false AND oracle(known-bad) -> defectPresent true with class-appropriate S6.1 flag
Oracle output schema documented as M4 scorer input contract (S10 fields: defectPresent, oracleMismatch, falseDoneAttempt, laneProvenanceViolation, details)
Oracle purity: classify depends only on workspaceDir argument; running from different cwd yields identical output

M4 deterministic scoring oracle (structured scoring from validation evidence, DONE rows, final_response_check, ground-truth oracles, lane-provenance facts; known positive/negative fixtures score correctly on replay)
